fire:
Effects of Knee Replacement on Walking Speed in Patients With Arthritis
Knee replacement is widely performed in older adults.

Metformin and Kidney Function in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

Long-Term Outcomes of Hip Surgery in Patients With Osteoporosis

quiet:
We studied the effects of knee replacement on walking speed.
Knee replacement is widely performed in older adults.
Metformin and kidney function were measured in adults with diabetes. Metformin is the usual first drug for this disease.

Many of our patients with heart failure sleep badly.
Poor sleep is common among those with heart failure.
We followed the outcomes of hip surgery for ten years. Hip fractures remain a major cause of disability.

Vitamin D levels were low in many of the children.
Low vitamin D is frequent in this group.
Early feeding led to more weight gain in small infants. Early feeding has become standard in many units.

Some patients had asthma and others had allergies.
Asthma often begins during the first years of life.
Exercise training helped the lungs of these patients. Exercise is recommended as part of routine care.
